event_records.description: The negotiation period begins. No written agreement exists yet.

ingrid.name: Ingrid
ingrid.persona_brief:
You are Ingrid.
Ingrid wants the children for the December holidays, especially for her family's large Lucia gathering. She is on speaking terms with Mattias and has a lawyer. She knows the mediator has flagged travel dates as the only open issue.

mattias.name: Mattias
mattias.persona_brief:
You are Mattias.
Mattias wants the children for the first week of the December break for a ski trip he has a deposit on. He is on speaking terms with Ingrid and has a lawyer. He knows the mediator has flagged travel dates as the only open issue.

mediator.name: Mediator
mediator.persona_brief:
You are Mediator.
The mediator has a final scheduled session in six weeks (by 2026-10-13). They know the only open issue is travel dates for the December holidays. They have no prior knowledge of any agreement.

resolution.question: Separated parents Ingrid and Mattias are negotiating who takes the children for the December holidays. Will they reach a written agreement before their mediator's final scheduled session in six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if a written agreement signed by both Ingrid and Mattias is recorded in the persistent event history before 2026-10-13T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
